# A plain logos build for wasm injects the 4096 stride default with no
# user flags; plain go and non-wasm logos builds do not.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
env GOOS=js
env GOARCH=wasm
logos build -a -x .
stderr 'logosloopstride=4096'
go build -a -x .
! stderr 'logosloopstride'
env GOOS=
env GOARCH=
logos build -a -x .
! stderr 'logosloopstride'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/preemptwasm

go 1.27

-- m/main.go --
package main

//go:noinline
func spin(n int) int {
	s := 0
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		s += i
	}
	return s
}

func main() {
	println(spin(100))
}
